findings.title: TLS Endpoint Unreachable or Non-TLS Port
findings.description: Could not establish a TLS session on this port during the assessment window.
findings.remediation: Confirm the port is expected to serve TLS and is reachable from the scanner's network position.

findings.title: Missing Content-Security-Policy header
findings.description: No CSP header was returned, leaving the app more exposed to XSS and data-injection attacks that a well-formed policy would otherwise mitigate.
findings.remediation: Define and ship a CSP restricting script/style/img sources to trusted origins; start in Report-Only mode, then enforce.

findings.title: Missing X-Frame-Options / anti-clickjacking header
findings.description: Neither X-Frame-Options nor a frame-ancestors CSP directive was present, allowing the page to be framed.
findings.remediation: Add 'X-Frame-Options: DENY' or a CSP 'frame-ancestors' directive scoped to trusted origins.

findings.title: Missing X-Content-Type-Options header
findings.description: Without 'nosniff', some browsers may MIME-sniff responses, enabling certain content-type confusion attacks.
findings.remediation: Add 'X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff' at the reverse proxy or framework middleware layer.

findings.title: Missing HTTP Strict Transport Security (HSTS)
findings.description: The server did not advertise HSTS, so clients aren't instructed to always use HTTPS for this host.
findings.remediation: Add 'Strict-Transport-Security: max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains' once all subdomains are HTTPS-ready.

findings.title: Missing Referrer-Policy header
findings.description: No Referrer-Policy was set, which can leak full URLs (including sensitive query params) to third parties.

findings.title: Exposed .env file
findings.description: A .env file was reachable and may contain credentials, API keys, or database connection strings.
findings.remediation: Remove the artifact from the web root and block the path at the reverse proxy; rotate any credentials that may have been exposed.

findings.title: Session Cookie Missing Security Flags: session_token
findings.description: Cookie 'session_token' is missing: HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite. This increases exposure to session theft via XSS (missing HttpOnly), transmission over plaintext HTTP (missing Secure), or cross-site request forgery (missing SameSite).
findings.remediation: Set HttpOnly, Secure, and SameSite=Lax (or Strict) on all session/auth cookies.

findings.title: JWT Missing Expiration Claim
findings.description: The token carries no 'exp' claim, so once issued it may be valid indefinitely if the server doesn't enforce expiry out-of-band.
findings.remediation: Include a short-lived 'exp' claim and enforce it server-side on every request.

findings.title: Error-Based SQL Injection Indicator on 'search_query'
findings.evidence: Injecting a single quote into 'search_query' surfaced a database error signature ('sqlite3.operationalerror'), HTTP 500.
findings.description: The parameter appears to be concatenated directly into a SQL statement rather than passed as a bound parameter, and the resulting database error is reflected in the response.
findings.remediation: Rewrite the query using parameterized statements / prepared statements or an ORM; never interpolate user input into SQL text. Suppress raw DB error output in production.

findings.title: Reflected XSS Indicator on 'msg'
findings.evidence: Probe marker 'vaXssProbe1337<z>' was reflected verbatim (unescaped) in the response body, HTTP 200.
findings.description: User-controlled input is reflected into the response without context-appropriate output encoding, which a real payload could use to execute script in a victim's browser.
findings.remediation: Apply context-aware output encoding (HTML entity encoding at minimum) wherever user input is rendered, and set a restrictive CSP as defense-in-depth.

findings.title: Broken Object Level Authorization (BOLA/IDOR)
findings.evidence: Tenant A's token retrieved Tenant B's object at http://127.0.0.1:5055/api/v1/customers/2 with HTTP 200.
findings.description: Object-level ownership is not being enforced: a caller can access another tenant's resource purely by knowing/guessing its identifier.
findings.remediation: Enforce `resource.owner_id == context.user_id` (or equivalent tenant scoping) at the data-access layer for every object-returning endpoint, not just in the UI.

findings.title: Broken Function Level Authorization (BFLA)
findings.evidence: Low-privilege token reached admin-only endpoint with HTTP 200.
findings.description: A privileged/admin function is reachable by a low-privilege authenticated user.
findings.remediation: Add explicit role/permission checks (RBAC/PBAC) on every privileged endpoint, enforced server-side — never rely on the client hiding the button.
